name: Branded Screen Printing & Embroidery
old_description: Are you looking for high quality apparel? Check out our most popular garments.
about:
Branded Screen Printing & Embroidery was founded in 2009 in Reno, Nevada, as a locally owned and operated shop focused on simplifying custom apparel for area businesses, schools, teams, and events. The company began on Moana Lane with the goal of keeping production in-house to maintain quality and speed, a model it still follows today.

The company provides a full range of decoration services including screen printing, embroidery, direct-to-film (DTF/UCP) printing, promotional products, vinyl decals, signs and banners, trade show displays, graphic design, jersey sublimation, online company stores, and contract printing. All production is handled at its Reno facility, allowing control over quality and turnaround. The shop serves both local customers in Reno, Sparks, and Carson City and ships orders nationwide.

Its customer base spans businesses needing work shirts, polos, jackets, and uniforms; K-12 schools ordering spirit wear and fundraiser items; youth and adult sports teams requiring jerseys and practice gear; nonprofits producing volunteer and event apparel; event organizers sourcing staff shirts, giveaways, and banners; and industrial crews in construction, trades, and warehouses seeking hi-vis and durable workwear.

Branded emphasizes in-house production as a differentiator, citing faster communication, consistent quality, and a standard turnaround of five to seven business days after proof approval, with rush options available. Screen printing minimums start at 12 pieces, and some decoration methods have no minimums. Every order includes a digital proof before production, and customers work directly with branding advisors for design support, apparel selection, and timeline management.
